answer: The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, split across independent auditors. Work waits on the shale until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the dawn of the next round. By the thread of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
